subject: [PATCH 31/60] cgroup/cpuset: inherit common memory when a nodemask is private only

reviews.author: Gregory Relay
reviews.summary: The reviewer noted that the current implementation of guarantee_online_mems() does not handle the case where a cpuset's effective mems mask contains only private memory nodes without any common memory nodes, potentially leading to an unsatisfiable condition for system allocations. They suggested modifying the function to walk up the hierarchy until it finds a cpuset with some common memory online.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch modifies the behavior of cgroup/cpuset to inherit common memory when a nodemask is private only, preventing unsatisfiable conditions and OOM errors due to lack of accessible memory nodes. The change affects how cpusets handle private memory nodes, ensuring that tasks do not end up with private-only masks in certain scenarios. The patch introduces subtle differences between v1 and v2 modes, but ultimately resolves all cases by inheriting only common nodes when a nodemask is private. This change aims to improve system stability and prevent infinite fault retry loops caused by unsatisfiable memory conditions.
